description: This file defines an Android activity named Tabs5 that demonstrates tab scrolling with multiple tabs in an Android application. It extends TabActivity and implements TabContentFactory to dynamically create tab content views.

classes.name: Tabs5
classes.description: An activity that displays a scrollable tab interface with 30 tabs, demonstrating tab scrolling functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds multiple tabs to the TabHost.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Creates a TextView for each tab's content, displaying a message with the tab's tag.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up the tab interface with multiple tabs.

methods.name: createTabContent
methods.description: Factory method to create content views for tabs dynamically based on the tag.
